 (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT format, ',') FROM dim_store) formats,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date x ON x.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE x.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND x.fiscal_period=2) lines_p2,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date x ON x.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE x.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND x.fiscal_period=2) dist_lines_p2,
 (SELECT COUNT(*)-COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id,line_no)) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date x ON x.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE x.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND x.fiscal_period=2) dup_receipt_lines,
 (SELECT COUNT(*)-COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line) dup_returns,
 (SELECT COUNT(*)-COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM fact_return_line) multi_returns_per_line

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, f.quantity, s.store_id, s.format, p.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2)
SELECT s.format, COUNT(*) lines, SUM(s.net_amount) sold_net, COUNT(r.return_line_id) ret_lines, SUM(r.refund_net) refund,
 SUM(CASE WHEN r.refund_net > s.net_amount+0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_refund,
 SUM(CASE WHEN r.quantity_returned > s.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_qty,
 SUM(CASE WHEN s.net_amount<0 OR s.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg_lines,
 SUM(CASE WHEN r.refund_net<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg_refund,
 SUM(CASE WHEN s.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) testlines,
 SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) s999
FROM sold s LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.sales_line_id=s.sales_line_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'orphan_returns' k, COUNT(*) n FROM fact_return_line r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'return_before_sale', COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id WHERE r.return_date < f.sale_date
UNION ALL SELECT 'max_return_lag_days', MAX(r.return_date - f.sale_date) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
UNION ALL SELECT 'max_return_date_epoch', CAST(MAX(return_date)-DATE '2026-01-01' AS BIGINT) FROM fact_return_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_sales_ids_all', COUNT(*)-COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM fact_sales_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_receipt_line_all', COUNT(*)-COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id,line_no)) FROM fact_sales_line

WITH dups AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT f.sale_date >= DATE '2025-05-26' AND f.sale_date<= DATE '2025-06-22' inP2, date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) m, COUNT(*) n, MIN(f.sales_line_id) mnid, MAX(f.sales_line_id) mxid,
 MIN(f.etl_loaded_at) l0, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) l1, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) receipts
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dups d USING (receipt_id, line_no)
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, s.format
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
    AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'),
refunds AS (
  SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, s.format AS store_format,
       ROUND(SUM(s.net_amount), 2) AS sold_net, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0), 2) AS refunded_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(s.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM sold s LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.sales_line_id = s.sales_line_id
GROUP BY s.format ORDER BY s.format

SELECT s.format, COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores, COUNT(DISTINCT s.format||s.store_id) x, MIN(f.sale_date) d0, MAX(f.sale_date) d1,
  MAX(f.net_amount) maxnet, MIN(f.net_amount) minnet, ROUND(AVG(f.net_amount),2) avgnet,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate))>0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) vat_mismatch,
  MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) lastload
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
